judge.rationale: The candidate fundamentally diverged from the issue specification in its own `.lore/dod.md` and implementation. It named the frames and types `list_sessions` / `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the required `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationCursor`). It completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` flag, the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, and `StoreCannotList`, and explicitly violated the acceptance criterion by returning an empty list `{type: 'session_list', sessions: []}` when `store.listFor` is missing instead of an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame. Validation also allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of enforcing 1–200, and when `listFor` throws, it logs `error.message` (which the spec forbids to avoid leaking store details/credentials) instead of `sessionId` and error type. Finally, it left `.lore/dod.md` tracked in the repository and skipped updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
